description: Fails an API signing key created more than 90 days ago (adjust the value to your own rotation policy -- there's no decisions.* config field for this, it's a Custom-Test-level threshold). Mirrors AWS 'IAM Access Key Rotation'. keyCreatedAt is OCI's own time_created on the key, read straight through. withinLastDays is a confirmed real Drata operator (drata/platform's engine-default-operators). Confirmed live 2026-09-24: two real api_key records read back with real keyCreatedAt timestamps (2025-07-22 and 2026-09-24) -- push this test against both to see one pass and one fail.
